label: Sudd inundation (MODIS, monthly) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 (Terra) 8-day via Microsoft Planetary Computer; MCD43A4 NBAR for 12 missing Terra tile-composites (Sep-Oct 2022, Jan and Nov 2023)
basis: Sep-Dec high-water-season share (%) of cloud-free MODIS 8-day composites classified as open water or flooded vegetation (the product's own annual-peak window; Jun-Sep is mostly cloud over the Sudd). 2025 is omitted: Planetary Computer has no MODIS reflectance for 4 Jul - 24 Nov 2025.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in percentage points/yr. brown = drier / less water, teal = wetter / more water; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
